guidebook.intro: School: the classroom, subjects and homework.

tips.title: Commands to a class
body: Teachers speak to the whole class with **ki-…-os**: **Kisomaros!** (read!), **Kigiros!** (write!), **Kiirarosi!** (listen!).
**Akiro** is a word, **ŋakiro** words. **Ekalamu** pen, **epapula** paper.

tips.title: Aingereza, ehesabu
body: Languages take **A-**: **Aingereza** English, **Ateso** the Ateso language. **Ehesabu** maths, **esayansi** science.

culture.title: Learning in two languages
body: Children in Teso learn in Ateso in the first school years, then mostly in English. Ateso was written early, with Bible translations and school readers.
